name: Публичные организации
changes: Independent news/events load tasks and error states; retry retains confirmed rows and page cursor. Late responses are rejected after account changes.
Cursor pages of 12 organization publications replace the fixed first-12 limit. Upcoming events use an indexed endDate query; ongoing sessions remain visible.
Organization detail resolves the exact ID, exposes loading/error/retry/back, keeps offline cache and removes denied/missing cached content without replacing other catalog pages.
Catalog avoids duplicate initial reads and false initial empty state. Debounced search can continue loading within the existing 120-item bound.
Guest personal filters request sign-in; blocked accounts cannot interact. Own/foreign edit/delete entries respect the existing server-backed permissions.
Photos load only on demand, support refresh/retry and explicit fullscreen dismissal; public gallery hides the editor capacity label.
Community page errors remain visible; account changes clear stale member data. Public official team versus authenticated subscriber access follows the existing policy.
Activity uses localized titles and summaries, applies secondary event categories and guards malformed age ranges.

Accessibility layouts stack hero metadata, activity content and team rows; contact values wrap fully rather than truncate. Gallery close action has a contrasting black toolbar. Map coordinates are validated.
Detail destinations receive the same repositories as their parent; DEBUG fixtures cover role menus, paging, errors, content destinations, subscription and gallery.

evidence.baseline: build/block07-baseline.xcresult: rapid-tab regression reproduced before the fix

rolesAndPublicRoutes.failure: AX test could not reach the section row; normal public routes, own/foreign role menus, retry, save/subscription and guest/blocked scenarios passed. Follow-up below.

finalDataflowAndDestinations.failure: AX offscreen team button; found event metadata expanding the screen at maximum font size. Corrected by adaptive metadata/card layout.

finalAccessibilityAndRegressions.note: All six German dark maximum-font tabs and the shared header passed. Old contact driver overscrolled; old unblock driver omitted the existing confirmation.
All persisted contact fields; hide/confirm/unhide/confirm round-trip.
Final wrapping contact values; German dark maximum text plus alternate de/light and uk/dark normal-size routes.
Twelve section changes across de/light and uk/dark; waits for the selected content before each capture.

visual.environment: iPhone 17e iOS 26.5 simulator, deterministic DEBUG fixtures
visual.transitionFollowup: Selected-content readiness assertion passed; final de/light contacts screenshot visually confirmed.

roles.menus: App owner, app admin, own org owner/admin/moderator, mixed, member and warned; each own and foreign organization. Guest/blocked covered separately.
roles.subscriberPolicy: Existing policy permits usable authenticated accounts to view subscribers; guests/blocked cannot. No unrequested policy change was made.
roles.managementBoundary: Full editor, photo mutations, ownership/role changes and request workflows are block 8. This block validates public routes and permitted entry points.

production.additiveIndex: events: sourceType ASC, organizationId ASC, moderationStatus ASC, endDate ASC, implicit __name__ ASC
production.exactQueryReadback: First and cursor-following pages succeeded for both news and upcoming organization events; no overlapping IDs.
production.compatibility: Additive index only; previous app queries, rules and function contracts unchanged. Admin API query timings are not end-user device latency.

boundaries.searchScope: Local matching over loaded content; automatic continuation capped at 120, manual Load more remains. Not global server full-text search.
boundaries.runtime: iPhone 17e iOS 26.5 simulator with deterministic DEBUG fixtures, uk/light and de/dark maximum Dynamic Type. No claim of a full live owner-account end-to-end journey.
boundaries.externalServices: Phone, email, maps, system share and real photo downloads/uploads need physical-device acceptance; source routes reviewed. No real subscriptions/comments were written.
boundaries.transitions: Normal tab/content/back flow and network retry observed in UI tests/video. No claim that every possible production timing or frame was measured.

hostedCI.note: Started after the source push. Local targeted results passed as documented; this run has not reached a terminal result.
